LanguageData.PhobosRadioWatch_InspectDesk: Radio watch: {NAME} at the desk; {COUNT} listening in all.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWatch_InspectHandhelds: Radio watch: {NAME} on a hand-held; {COUNT} listening in all.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWatch_InspectOnCall: Radio watch: nobody awake is listening. A call will ring the selective call and wake {NAME}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWatch_InspectNoOnCall: Radio watch: nobody is listening, and nobody asleep has radio watch in their work for the selective call to wake. Calls will be missed.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWatch_InspectNobody: Radio watch: nobody is listening. Calls will be missed until someone keeps watch at a desk or carries a hand-held in touch.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioWatch_NobodyHeard: {CALLER} called, but nobody was listening at the radio.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioLog_CallMissed: Missed call: {CALLER} called about {WHAT}, and nobody was listening.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioLog_CallHeardDesk: {LISTENER} took a call at the desk from {CALLER}, about {WHAT}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioLog_CallHeardSelectiveCall: The selective call rang and woke {LISTENER} to take a call from {CALLER}, about {WHAT}.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioOrders_ButtonDesc: What whoever is listening at the radio may do without asking you.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioOrders_Intro: Whoever is listening at the radio carries these out without asking you, and the Log says who did. An order ticked on any working station of this colony counts.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioOrders_AnswerNeighbours: Answer neighbours who ask for help
LanguageData.PhobosRadioOrders_AnswerNeighboursDesc: When a neighbour asks for your best doctor or mechanic on the radio, they go at once, as if you had said yes, and you get a message in place of the letter.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioOrders_AskTrader: Ask an allied trader in when there is silver to spend
LanguageData.PhobosRadioOrders_AskTraderDesc: Once a day, in the morning, if the colony has at least the silver below, whoever is listening asks an ally in reach to send a trader caravan.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioOrders_TraderSilver: When the colony has at least {SILVER} silver:
LanguageData.PhobosRadioOrders_AskTraderCost: Each request costs goodwill, as asking by radio does, and a hostile settlement listening may ambush the caravan on its way.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioOrders_NeighbourAnswered: {LISTENER} answered {FACTION} on the radio: {COLONIST} goes on the radio to help them for an hour.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioOrders_TraderAsked: With {SILVER} silver to spend, {LISTENER} called {FACTION} for a trader. {REPLY}
LanguageData.PhobosRadioOrders_TraderNoOrder: No working station here has the order to ask a trader in.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioOrders_TraderNotEnough: The colony has {SILVER} silver, less than the {THRESHOLD} the order asks for.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioOrders_TraderOnWay: A trader asked for by radio is already on the way.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioOrders_TraderNobody: Nobody awake is listening at the radio to make the call.
LanguageData.PhobosRadioOrders_TraderNoAlly: No ally in reach can send a trader now.
